quickAnswerHtml: Lung Shall Kitchen is a Bib Gourmand restaurant in the MICHELIN Guide Thailand 2026, in Chon Buri, in the Noen Plub Wan, Nong Prue area (East Pattaya). Budget around THB 100–200, and it's mostly walk-in / queue at the door

blocks.html:
Say "Pattaya" and most people picture a beachfront seafood buffet or a fancy sea-view restaurant. But the place MICHELIN handed a Bib Gourmand two years running (2025 and 2026) is a plain open-air wooden house on Nong Mai Kaen Road, in the Noen Plub Wan area on the East Pattaya side, a fair distance back from the sea. The restaurant's name is Lung Shall Kitchen, or in full on Wongnai, "Lung Shall Kitchen Som Tam Pa Duang" — a name that tells you straight away this is a real uncle-and-auntie operation, not a built-up brand. And that's exactly the charm that won MICHELIN over — simple, straightforward cooking from fresh ingredients, made to order one dish at a time, with nothing more complicated than skill and care behind it.

The dish everyone talks about first is the deep-fried triggerfish in fish sauce, fried so crisp you can eat the bones, a dish MICHELIN singled out by name. Next comes the curry-fried crab roe curry, rich in the way east-coast seaside home kitchens do it, squid stir-fried in black ink sauce using fresh squid from the Chon Buri area, and a young coconut shoot and fresh shrimp som tam that pairs the sweet crunch of tender coconut shoot with the punchy heat of the mortar — that last one is probably down to "Pa Duang," the other name on the sign. Prices stay true to the Bib Gourmand promise: about 100–200 THB a dish, and even ordering enough to fill the table averages out to just 250–400 THB a head — less than some beachfront hotels charge for parking.

What locals in Pattaya know is that Noen Plub Wan is where actual residents live and eat, not a tourist route. The restaurant sits just before the Noen Plub Wan Ua-Athon village, so the atmosphere is a side of Pattaya most visitors never see — quieter, more real, and tasty without the tourist markup. If you're driving the Pattaya-Jomtien loop and getting tired of beach-zone food, a ten-minute detour east shows you exactly why the MICHELIN inspectors have kept coming back off the beaten path two years straight. The one catch: bring patience, because everything really is cooked fresh, one dish at a time. Multiple reviews agree the wait can run long, but once the first dish lands on the table, most people forget they were ever annoyed.

blocks.name: Lung Shall Kitchen
blocks.descHtml:
Lung Shall Kitchen is walk-in only — no advance bookings — but you can call ahead with questions at 086-089-1692. It's easy on the wallet: about 100–200 THB a dish, averaging 250–400 THB a head for a full seafood-and-som-tam spread. The restaurant is open roughly 10:00–20:00, though MICHELIN notes an afternoon break from 14:00–17:30, so for a sure visit come for lunch before 2pm or dinner after 5:30pm. Keep this in mind: the restaurant is closed on the 13th and 26th of every month — miss those two dates and you'll have made the trip for nothing.

The restaurant sits on Nong Mai Kaen Road, in the Noen Plub Wan, Nong Prue area on the East Pattaya side, just before the Noen Plub Wan Ua-Athon village. Your own car is the easiest way in, since it's outside the tourist walking zone. Everything is cooked fresh to order, so expect some wait — order everything up front, then settle in and enjoy the breeze in the open-air wooden dining room while the food comes out. Dress is casual.

faq.q: Do I need to book ahead at Lung Shall Kitchen?
faq.a: No booking needed and none taken — it's walk-in only. If you want to check ahead, call 086-089-1692, but since everything is cooked fresh to order, budget extra time for the wait

faq.q: How much should I budget for Lung Shall Kitchen?
faq.a: About 100–200 THB a dish, averaging 250–400 THB per person for a full meal — very affordable for a two-time Bib Gourmand restaurant

faq.q: What should I order at Lung Shall Kitchen?
faq.a: The dish MICHELIN singles out is the deep-fried triggerfish in fish sauce, fried so crisp you can eat the bones, along with the curry-fried crab roe curry. The squid stir-fried in black ink sauce and the young coconut shoot and fresh shrimp som tam are also standouts not to miss

faq.q: What are Lung Shall Kitchen's hours, and does it close any days?
faq.a: Open roughly 10:00–20:00, with an afternoon break from 14:00–17:30, and closed on the 13th and 26th of every month. The restaurant is on Nong Mai Kaen Road in the Noen Plub Wan area, East Pattaya — driving there yourself is easiest
